{{Quote|Leave a distress strobe with my fighter.|Darth Vader|<ref name="Vader Adrift">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|Vader Adrift}}</ref>}}
A '''distress strobe''' was a type of locator device designed for use in [[Time/Legends|times]] of distress. After being rescued from his crippled [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE interceptor]] following the [[Infiltration of the Tarkin|destruction]] of the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] left a distress strobe with his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] for later retrieval.
